# OpenCC generated data in Relaxer

This is embedded character-mapping data, not a distributed OpenCC shared library.
No OpenCC MSYS2 package revision applies. The frozen generated table is tracked in
Relaxer commit faa44ded636e4808600e2ded04c93352918a8dda and retained unchanged.
The supplied pinned upstream STCharacters dictionary, first-target selection and
identity-removal transform reproduce its 3,881 pairs byte for byte. This proves
content correspondence, not which upstream revision the original importer used.
The upstream project and dictionary are Apache-2.0 licensed; LICENSE is included.
The notice-marked source is provided for corresponding-source publication, with
the downstream changes made explicit. Its only difference is the comment header.
The frozen application and generated source have not been altered in place.
Full OpenCC C++ library build instructions are not used by Relaxer; its actual
build input is this generated include, compiled by the frozen CMake product build.
